name: PLC analog output
summary: A PLC analog output provides a documented variable voltage or current signal to another device.
description: A PLC analog output provides a documented variable voltage or current signal to another device. The receiving input and output common must match the configured signal range.
readingNotes: Check active/passive loop roles for current outputs.

distinction: An analog output commands a continuous signal; it is different from a switched relay contact.
